message.content: {"B_expression":"-1/(2*(1+u)*((1+u)+sqrt((1+u)**2+r))**2)","C_expression":"-1/(2*(1+u))","derivation":"In the inner region (chi_r=chi_u=1) the update is g=r/2+r^2*B+u*r*C. The exact root requires z_new=(1+u)+g=sqrt((1+u)^2+r), i.e. g=sqrt((1+u)^2+r)-(1+u). Rationalizing: g=r/((1+u)+sqrt((1+u)^2+r)). I decompose this as g=r/(2(1+u)) + r^2*B + u*r*C by choosing C=-1/(2(1+u)) so the u-dependent linear term is absorbed, leaving B to supply the remaining r^2-scaled correction. The algebraic identity sqrt(a+r)-sqrt(a)-r/(2sqrt(a)) = -r^2/(2*sqrt(a)*(sqrt(a)+sqrt(a+r))^2) (with a=(1+u)^2, sqrt(a)=1+u>0) gives B=-1/(2(1+u)*((1+u)+sqrt((1+u)^2+r))^2) with no division by r. Both bodies are C-infinity on an open neighborhood of [-1/2,1/2]x[-1/4,1/4] since 1+u>=3/4>0 and (1+u)^2+r>=1/16>0 throughout. When u=0 this reduces to the source-only B(r)=-1/(2(1+sqrt(1+r))^2) with C=-1/2 (the C term multiplies u*r=0 so it is inert).","inspect":[{"file_id":"MATH/METHOD_GUIDE.md","limit":4096,"offset":0},{"file_id":"CALC/initial.json","limit":2048,"offset":0}],"note":"The pair (B,C) gives exact root z_new=sqrt(p) for all (r,u) in the inner chi-supported rectangle, not just u=0. A successor should verify: (1) at u=0 the C term vanishes identically and B matches the R4 source formula; (2) the sqrt argument (1+u)^2+r stays >=1/16>0 on the closed outer rectangle so no branch cut or domain break occurs; (3) outside the chi support the program degenerates to g=r/2 (linear reference) as designed. The whole residual E=(z+g)^2-p is zero in the inner region; any nonzero E in feedback outside that region is expected from the r/2 fallback."}
